title: Harden ANTLR Python generation with post-generation lint normalization

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementing source-level fix: make parser generation deterministic and scanner-compliant by running post-generation cleanup (ruff PIE790 fix + black) on generated Python parser files.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented source-level fix. Updated Makefile generate-python-parser target to post-process generated LuaParser with  and , and updated validation README manual generation instructions with the same steps. This makes regenerated parser output deterministic and codeql/format-compliant without manual hand edits.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Correction note: post-generation commands are python3 -m poetry run ruff check tactus/validation/generated/LuaParser.py --select PIE790 --fix and python3 -m poetry run black tactus/validation/generated/LuaParser.py.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Attempted to validate by regenerating parser in this environment, but blocked: Docker unavailable ( not found), Java unavailable, and antlr tool not installed. Build target Generating Python parser from Lua grammar...
Using Docker with eclipse-temurin:17-jre...
docker run --rm \
		-v "$(pwd)":/work \
		-v /tmp:/tmp \
		-w /work \
		eclipse-temurin:17-jre \
		java -jar /tmp/antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar \
		-Dlanguage=Python3 \
		-visitor \
		-no-listener \
		-o /work/tactus/validation/generated \
		/work/tactus/validation/grammar/LuaLexer.g4 \
		/work/tactus/validation/grammar/LuaParser.g4 fails before generation. Source-level post-generation normalization steps remain in Makefile/README and are ready for environments with Docker/Java.

comments.text: Correction: validation run was performed from a login shell where Docker is available. Executed make generate-python-parser, then verified with python3 -m poetry run ruff check tactus/validation/generated/LuaParser.py, python3 -m poetry run black --check tactus/validation/generated/LuaParser.py, and python3 -m pytest -q tests/core/test_yaml_parser.py (all passed).
